body: I hesitate for only a moment before I see my neighbor's dog begin to growl ominously at me. My heart races as the animal lunges forward, its eyes wild and crazed. Panic grips me, but instinct kicks in too, urging me to retreat slowly towards the house. My hands automatically seek cover under the porch railing, fingers curling protectively around the rough wood.
